description: Judging rubric for coding-task solutions, derived from 101 structured review findings across the nuri-com organization (non-custodial Bitcoin/Lightning wallet). Weights reflect that a single crypto/security mistake can be catastrophic.

security_and_privacy.description: Key material handling, cryptographic correctness, attack surface reduction, data exposure

rules.name: No private keys in localStorage
rules.description: Persisting private keys, seeds, mnemonics, or credentials in localStorage breaks the security boundary. localStorage is accessible to any JS running on the same origin, including XSS payloads.

rules.name: No hardcoded secrets or host inventory
rules.description: Hardcoded secrets, API keys, host inventories, or operator details in source code or docs must never be committed.

rules.name: No Math.random for cryptographic operations
rules.description: Math.random() is not cryptographically secure. Use crypto.getRandomValues() or the appropriate platform API for nonces, salts, and key generation.

rules.name: Sandbox WebView/iframe content
rules.description: WebView and iframe content must be sandboxed by default. Check for sandbox attributes, CSP headers, and restricted origins.

rules.name: Disable unnecessary PRF output
rules.description: PRF (Pseudo-Random Function) output from passkeys should only be requested when actually needed. Paths that only carry assertions should not request PRF output.

rules.name: Complete keychain wipe on logout
rules.description: wipeAllKeychainData() and similar cleanup functions must remove ALL aliased entries, not just the primary key. Incomplete wipes leave orphaned credentials.

rules.name: No silent key-storage downgrade
rules.description: Key storage must not silently downgrade from persistent secure storage to a volatile in-memory cache. If secure storage fails, the user must be informed.

rules.name: No eval() or Function() constructor
rules.description: eval() and new Function() execute arbitrary strings as code, enabling injection attacks.

rules.name: No innerHTML with dynamic content
rules.description: Setting innerHTML with dynamic content enables XSS. Use textContent, createElement, or a sanitization library. Matches innerHTML = (anything except ===), including string literals which may contain dynamic concatenation.

rules.name: No insecure HTTP for sensitive endpoints
rules.description: Sensitive API calls must use HTTPS. HTTP connections are vulnerable to MITM attacks.

rules.name: Verify signatures and assertions
rules.description: All signature verification, assertion validation, and challenge checking must be performed correctly. Missing or incorrect verification allows forgery.

rules.name: No nonce reuse
rules.description: Cryptographic nonces must never be reused. In MuSig2 and signing operations, nonce reuse leaks private keys.

functional_correctness.description: Does the solution actually solve the issue? Correct API usage, error handling, edge cases, accessibility

rules.name: Correct enum and API constant usage
rules.description: Enum values must match the actual library API. Example: LocalAuthentication.SecurityLevel.BIOMETRIC (not BIOMETRIC_STRONG which doesn't exist in expo-local-authentication).

rules.name: No silent catch blocks
rules.description: Empty catch blocks swallow errors silently. At minimum, log the error so failures are diagnosable.

rules.name: Optional chaining for nullable callbacks
rules.description: Callbacks that may be undefined must use optional chaining (?.) to avoid runtime TypeError. Example: onError?.() not onError(). Only flags known callback names to avoid false positives.

rules.name: Handle URL objects in fetch/XHR interceptors
rules.description: Fetch and XMLHttpRequest interceptors must handle URL objects, not just strings. Passing new URL(...) to an interceptor that only handles strings causes CORS bypass or request failure.

rules.name: Visible focus state for keyboard navigation
rules.description: Removing :focus and :focus-visible outlines leaves keyboard users without navigation indicators. Provide an alternative visible focus style.

rules.name: Don't disable browser zoom
rules.description: Disabling browser zoom violates accessibility guidelines (WCAG 1.4.4). Users with visual impairments need zoom.

rules.name: Implement required WebView interfaces
rules.description: WebView shims must implement all required interfaces like injectedJavaScriptObject. Missing interfaces cause runtime crashes in dependent code.

rules.name: Clear stale state on new operations
rules.description: Starting a new async operation must clear stale results from previous runs. Stale armed results, cached responses, or pending states cause incorrect behavior.

rules.name: No OTA-incompatible native module calls
rules.description: OTA updates cannot change native modules. Code that calls native modules not present in the current binary must be gated or have fallbacks.

data_integrity.description: Data consistency, integration correctness, state synchronization, no silent downgrades

rules.name: Unify address sources across integrations
rules.description: When multiple integrations (Monerium, Arkade, Gnosis) need a default address, they must use a unified source. Divergent address sources cause funds to be sent to wrong addresses.

rules.name: No silent storage downgrade
rules.description: Storage operations must not silently downgrade from persistent to volatile. If persistent storage fails, surface the error to the user.

rules.name: Clear stale armed results
rules.description: When starting a new receive-claim prefetch or similar operation, clear stale armed results from previous runs.

rules.name: Make failed critical operations fatal
rules.description: Critical operations like IBAN moves must be fatal on failure. A failed move must not allow the migration to advance to the next step.

rules.name: Deduplicate sync requests
rules.description: Repeated sync requests (e.g., Arkade receive sync) must be deduplicated to prevent duplicate state writes and race conditions.

performance.description: Resource efficiency, unnecessary initialization, memory leaks, render optimization

rules.name: Don't initialize expensive resources on every call
rules.description: Expensive initializations (Arkade, crypto contexts, database connections) should be cached or lazy-loaded, not re-initialized on every operation.

rules.name: No memory leaks in event listeners
rules.description: Event listeners added in useEffect or component lifecycle must be cleaned up. Check for removeEventListener in cleanup.

rules.name: Memoize expensive computations
rules.description: Expensive computations in render paths should be memoized with useMemo/useCallback to prevent unnecessary re-computation.

maintainability.description: Code quality, naming, documentation, dead code, lint compliance

rules.name: No dead code or unused imports
rules.description: Unused imports and dead code should be removed. Check that all imported symbols are used. Requires LLM analysis — regex cannot reliably detect unused imports without cross-referencing.

rules.name: Label code fences in docs
rules.description: Code fences in markdown docs should have a language label (e.g., ```nginx, ```typescript) for syntax highlighting and lint compliance. Regex cannot distinguish opening from closing fences, so this requires LLM analysis.

rules.name: Use approved design system colors
rules.description: Colors should come from the approved design system, not hardcoded hex values.

rules.name: No duplicate code blocks
rules.description: Duplicated logic should be extracted into shared functions or components.

rules.name: Fix markdownlint violations
rules.description: Markdown docs should pass markdownlint (MD040: fenced code blocks should have a language). Moved to LLM — regex cannot distinguish opening from closing fences.

completeness.description: Did the solution address all requirements from the issue? Did it introduce regressions?

rules.name: Addresses all issue requirements
rules.description: The solution must address every requirement listed in the issue. Partial solutions are scored lower.

rules.name: No regressions introduced
rules.description: The solution must not break existing functionality. Check for removed features, changed APIs, or broken integrations.

rules.name: Includes tests for new functionality
rules.description: New functionality should include test coverage. Missing tests for critical paths is a minor penalty.

scoring.description: Each category is scored 0-100. Final score = weighted sum of category scores. Any hard_gate category with a critical violation gets score 0 for that category. Below pass_threshold = reject.
